evidence: https://armstrongcad.org/home/map (interactive map names no public parcel service)
note: Armstrong County Appraisal District publishes no public queryable parcel service or free file. The only public-agency parcel layer (TxGIO StratMap) is token-gated, and commercial vendors (Regrid, Acres, TaxNet, Equator, reportallusa) sell parcel data behind paywalls. No open ArcGIS service for Armstrong County was found in Hub/Online searches.
